description:
I tried a random Venezuelan spot in Harker Heights… and now I can’t stop going back 😭🔥

These arepas?? crispy outside, packed inside, and way too good to stay a secret 🤤

I’ve been lowkey gatekeeping this one… but it’s time.

📍 Arepitas Venezuelan Kitchen

If you know, you KNOW. If you don’t… you’re about to 👀

👇 I need to know:
Have you been here before? What did you order??
OR drop your favorite hidden food spot in Harker Heights—I’m trying them ALL 🔥

And if you’re new to the area or thinking about moving to Harker Heights… this is exactly why people love living here 💛

#HarkerHeightsTX #HarkerHeightsEats
